doc: stages/filters.geomdistance.rst: '``ring`` of ``True`` causes the polygon external ring to be used for distance computation, resulting in distances **inside** the polygon to be computed.' -- with ring true the same [0,9]x[0,9] polygon measures to its edge: a lattice point (x,y) is min(x, y, 9-x, 9-y) from the boundary, which is 0 on the 36 boundary columns (360 points) and at most 4 at the four central columns. The whole value set is {0,1,2,3,4}.
